text: undefiled: Or, perfect, or sincere
thy righteous judgments: Heb. judgments of thy righteousness
Open: Heb. Reveal
my counsellors: Heb. men of my counsel
melteth: Heb. droppeth
Turn away: Heb. make to pass
So shall I have werewith to answer him that reproacheth me: Or, so shall I answer him that reproveth me in a thing
at liberty: Heb. at large
favour: Heb. face
bands: Or, companies
right: Heb. righteousness
for my comfort: Heb. to comfort me
faithful: Heb. faithfulness
unto all generations: Heb. to generation and generation | abideth: Heb. standeth
they are ever with me: Heb. it is ever with me
taste!: Heb. palate
lamp: Or, candle
to perform: Heb. to do
puttest away: Heb. causeth to cease
as thou usest to do unto those: Heb. according to the custom towards those, etc.
righteous: Heb. righteousness | faithful: Heb. faithfulness
consumed me: Heb. cut me off
pure: Heb. tried or refined
taken hold: Heb. found me
and I shall keep thy testimonies: Or, that I may keep
Great: Or, many
Thy word is true from the beginning: Heb. The beginning of thy word is true
nothing shall offend them: Heb. they shall have no stumbling block
